headline: Council meetings to start at 5:30 p.m., with up to an hour of public comment
summary: Public comment would last up to 60 minutes under Rule 39, up from 30. The committee asked the city manager to consider a council budget priority process, in place of proposed Rules 61, 62 and 63. The review of Rule 5 on special meetings was filed with no change. A summary of Rule 35 will be added to future agendas.
decisions: Approved asking the city manager to consider a council budget priority process, 3-0.
Filed item 3A, the communication on proposed Rules 61, 62 and 63, 3-0.
Approved amending Rule 4 to start council meetings at 5:30 p.m. and Rule 39 to allow 60 minutes of public participation, 3-0.
Recommended filing the order on Rule 5 on special meetings, with no rule change, 3-0.
Approved putting a summary of Rule 35 on future agendas, 3-0.
Filed item 4C, the order on Rule 35, on the chair's confirmation.
discussion: Council meeting start time: Members debated a 5:30 p.m. start, a 6:00 p.m. start, and whether public comment should begin at 5:30 or 6:30. Public speakers said a 5:30 start would keep working residents from attending.

Budget priority process: The CFO said a March 1 deadline would come close to finalizing revenues, leaving little room to change priorities. Members said councilors want to give the city manager their priorities earlier, and the proposal moved the date to February 15.
Rule 35 enforcement: Members said the rule on speaking to an order should be applied the same way for every member. The city clerk said the rule has been in place for about 40 years.
Special meeting rule: Members said the rule has been used only once, and they saw no need to change it.
